steps.name: contract-and-channel-badge
steps.summary: Recorded the approved orders-owned IA and ProductVariant/ChannelProductRef inventory invariants (reservation, atomic post-fulfillment decrement, and absolute-quantity channel sync) in PRD, Architecture, and ADR. Added the canonical ChannelBadge API (channel, listingStatus, optional compact) with visible channel/status text and semantic Badge tones. Verified with npm run test -- --run tests/shared-primitives.test.ts tests/nav.test.ts and npm run lint (0 errors; 4 existing warnings).

steps.name: commerce-schema-and-invariants
steps.summary: Created canonical migration supabase/migrations/20260714154633_channel_commerce_operations.sql and synchronized supabase/schema.sql plus Prisma models for commerce variants, channel references/orders, reservations, fulfillments, and tracking imports. Every new public table has auth.uid() ownership defaults, authenticated owner RLS policy, and user_id index; external IDs and fulfillment idempotency are owner-scoped unique. finalize_order_fulfillment is a security-invoker, empty-search-path RPC that locks authenticated rows, performs one successful external fulfillment's on-hand decrement, reservation release, and OUTBOUND transaction atomically, and returns success without repeat decrement. Verified with npm run test -- --run tests/schema-contract.test.ts tests/commerce-schema.test.ts, npx prisma validate, and npm run lint (0 errors; 4 pre-existing warnings).

steps.name: channel-product-sync
steps.summary: Added server-only Naver POST /external/v1/products/search pagination (size 500) and Coupang seller-products paging plus bounded-concurrency detail snapshots, both normalized with SKU, listing, quantity, price/image, and raw attributes. Added syncProducts(channel?) to upsert channel_product_refs; only an exactly-one seller_sku ProductVariant match sets variant_id, while absent/ambiguous SKUs remain mapping-required without name matching or inventory mutation. Verified with npm run test -- --run tests/naver-api.test.ts tests/coupang-api.test.ts tests/channel-product-sync.test.ts (3 files, 8 tests passed) and npm run lint (0 errors; 4 existing warnings).

steps.name: product-management-workspace
steps.summary: Replaced the populated product tab with one ProductVariant table containing fixed Coupang/Naver ChannelBadge slots, internal available, sync gap, and last-sync columns. Added compact fixed views, search, one sync action with inline result metadata, and a shared channel-detail modal for image, price, external IDs, raw status, reported quantity, sync errors, and link/unlink. Preserved the legacy model/size/color creation flow when no commerce variants exist and retained the warehouse tab. Added an owner-verified linkVariant server action. Verified with npm run test -- --run tests/products-page.test.ts tests/master-data-manager.test.ts tests/product-management-workspace.test.ts (3 files, 8 tests passed) and npm run lint (0 errors; 4 existing warnings).

steps.name: order-ingestion-and-reservations
steps.summary: Added idempotent Naver/Coupang order and line upserts with seller SKU and external product references. Exact mappings create one active reservation only when a single warehouse has sufficient available quantity; unmapped, insufficient, or multi-warehouse candidates remain MAPPING_REQUIRED/EXCEPTION without changing on-hand inventory. Cancellation releases active reservations, repeat sync skips duplicate reservations, and manual assignment enforces one warehouse per order. Added /orders as the dense orders owner with fixed views, search/channel filtering, ChannelBadge text, and a row assignment control; updated navigation to 대시보드 / 주문 / 상품 관리 / 재고 운영 / 소싱 / 설정. Verified with npm run test -- --run tests/order-sync.test.ts tests/order-reservations.test.ts tests/orders-page.test.ts tests/nav.test.ts (4 files, 9 tests passed) and npm run lint (0 errors; 4 existing warnings).

steps.name: tracking-import-and-fulfillment
steps.summary: Added the orders-owned /orders/tracking-import workspace with file, header/mapping preset, preview, and dispatch stages using TableSurface, BasicDataTable, and Select; legacy /shipping now redirects and its duplicate owner was removed. Added immutable built-in presets, header fingerprints, normalized-row-only batch persistence, matching priority/exclusion rules, Naver 30-row dispatch batching, external-success-only fulfillment recording, RPC finalization, and RECONCILE_REQUIRED handling. Verified preset/matching/finalize/reconcile behavior with npm run test -- --run tests/excel.test.ts tests/tracking-import.test.ts tests/fulfillment.test.ts tests/shipping-page.test.ts (4 files, 7 tests passed) and npm run lint (0 errors; 4 existing warnings).

steps.name: inventory-sourcing-dashboard-integration
steps.summary: Added the shared ProductVariantCombobox with searchable product/option/SKU results and fixed Naver/Coupang ChannelBadge slots; it is reused by inventory add and sourcing arrival entry without free-text product creation. Inventory now shows onHand, committed, available, and incoming per warehouse, while sourcing keeps remaining ordered-received quantities as incoming. Replaced generic dashboard analytics with four order KPIs, a 14-day inbound/outbound view, warehouse onHand/committed/available, order exceptions, and upcoming sourcing; KPI links open the corresponding fixed order view. Expanded ChannelBadge to visible icon+text states for sold out, approval pending, mapping required, paused, and sync error, and persisted channel_reported stock snapshots. Missing optional commerce tables render safe empty states until the migration is applied. Final verification: 58 test files / 164 tests passed, lint passed with 0 errors and 4 pre-existing warnings, and npm run build passed. Browser verification covered dashboard, order exception deep-linking, products fallback, and inventory workspace.
